arrival: Ah, my new neighbour! Ẹ káàbọ̀. I am Baba. This plot is yours now. Start small. Lay one room.
moveIn: A roof over your head. Go inside. Put your things where you want them.
afternoon: Three o'clock. Now you will learn what your house is made of.
afterNepa: The fan sleeps, but a good house does not need it. Ask me, and I will show you.
evening: The sun is going. Sit. You did well today.

visits.text: Your sister is visiting next week. Will you add a room for her?
Harmattan dust is coming. Deeper eaves keep it off your walls.
The block house across the road is baking. Shall we show them what a courtyard does?
You have savings left. A taller wall lets the heat rise above your head.
